DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日は口座開設のご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are here to discuss opening an account today, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。予約したので、今日すぐ口座番号がもらえると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相談予約で即番号取得と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Since I had a reservation, I thought I would receive an account number right away today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought a consultation reservation meant receiving an account number immediately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 資料の確認と手続きが必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check your documents and complete the procedures.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。会社には相談の予約をしただけと伝え、開設済みとはまだ言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社へ予約のみで開設未完了と伝える意思を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. I will tell my company that I only booked a consultation, and I will not say the account is open yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State that you intend to tell your company you only have a reservation and the account opening is not complete. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご利用の目的をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me what you will use the account for.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 給与の受取です。会社から必要な情報の一覧も渡されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 給与受取目的と会社一覧を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: To receive my salary. My company also gave me a list of the information they need.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that it is for receiving your salary and show the company's list. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本人資料を確認しましょう。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらです。不足があれば教えてください。今日完了する前提で会社へ番号を約束しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 資料提示と不足確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here they are. Please tell me if anything is missing. I will not promise my company an account number on the assumption everything will be completed today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present your documents and ask whether anything is missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認後に進められる手続きをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking, we will explain which procedures can go ahead.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。受付、申込み、開設完了を分けて、どこまで済んだか最後に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付申込完了の進捗を分けて質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. At the end, I would like to ask how far things have progressed, distinguishing reception, application, and completed account opening.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about progress, distinguishing reception, application, and completion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 資料を担当へお見せください。本日確認できた段階と次の準備をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please show your documents to the staff member in charge. We will explain the stage confirmed today and what to prepare next.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble at the checkout?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ商品を二回読んでしまいました。現物は一つですが、画面は二個になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一商品二重読取で数量二と申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I scanned the same item twice. There is only one actual item, but the screen shows two.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that scanning one item twice has made the quantity two. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。先に払ってから返金を頼むのではなく、ここで数量を直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未支払で先に数量修正を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. Instead of paying first and asking for a refund afterward, I would like to correct the quantity here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not paid and want the quantity corrected first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 該当する商品を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please show me the item concerned.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この牛乳です。ほかの商品を減らして合計だけ合わせるのは違うと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 商品を特定し他商品の減算で合わせないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is this milk. I do not think reducing another item's quantity just to make the total match would be right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify the item and explain that you do not want another item subtracted to adjust the total. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この商品の数量を一個へ直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will change this item's quantity to one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。値段だけでなく、商品名と数量が一致するか見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 品名数量を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I will check that the item name and quantity match, not just the price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the item name and quantity against the goods. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have corrected it to one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認できました。残りの商品も数え、全部合ってから支払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全商品確認後の支払を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked it. I will count the remaining items too and pay once everything matches.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will pay after checking all the items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 牛乳は一個になっています。画面と現物を確認してからお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: The milk now shows one. Please check the screen against your actual items before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ボールが水路へ落ちました。浅く見えますが、自分で入って取ってよいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 水路へ落ちた球の回収方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: A ball fell into the water channel. It looks shallow, but I do not know whether I may go in and retrieve it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to retrieve the ball that fell into the channel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、誰か水路に入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is anyone in the channel now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ。子どもにも端から離れて待ってもらっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 誰も未入水で子どもは端を離れたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I have also asked the children to stay away from the edge and wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that nobody has entered the water and the children are away from the edge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 管理の担当が場所を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The maintenance staff will check the location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。ボールは曲がり角の手前です。流れているので、同じ場所に止まっているとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 流動する球の現地点を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. The ball is just before the bend. It is drifting, so it may not stay in the same place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Indicate the current location of the drifting ball. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 色と大きさを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell me its color and size.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 赤くて、小さいサッカーボールくらいです。水の中へ棒を入れて探るのもまだしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 色大きさと棒未使用を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is red, about the size of a small soccer ball. I have not tried probing the water with a stick either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State its color and size and that you have not used a stick. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ伝えるので、安全な所でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will inform the staff in charge, so please wait somewhere safe.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。子どもと通路側で待ち、取れない場合は無理に追いかけません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 安全な通路で待ち無理に追わないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: All right. I will wait with the children on the path side, and if it cannot be retrieved, I will not chase after it recklessly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wait on the safe path and will not chase it recklessly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 管理担当を呼びました。場所と色を伝え、回収できるか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have called the maintenance staff. We will tell them the location and color and check whether it can be retrieved.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 交通の案内をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like some transport information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人とは別々に来ました。私が乗る便と降りる場所を、同じ案内で伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人へ便と降車地を共有したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My friend and I came separately. I would like to use the same information to tell them which service I am taking and where I am getting off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to share your service and alighting point with your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 行き先をこちらの案内票へ記入できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can write your destination on this information sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この場所です。出発の場所だけ送っても、友人が同じ方向へ行くとは限りませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 出発地だけでは不十分と行先を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is this place. Sending only my departure point would not necessarily mean my friend travels in the same direction, would it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your destination and explain that the departure point alone is insufficient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 便の時刻と降りる地点を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the departure time and alighting point together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。友人には案内票の全体を送り、行き先の部分を切り取らないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 時刻行先が入る全体案内を送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I will send my friend the entire information sheet without cropping out the destination section.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will send the whole information sheet, including the time and destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 友人も同じ便に乗る予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is your friend planning to take the same service?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 間に合えば乗ります。無理なら到着後の場所で合流し、途中で探し回りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 間に合わない場合は到着側で合流すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: If they make it in time, yes. If they cannot, we will meet at the arrival location instead of wandering around looking for each other along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that if your friend cannot make it, you will meet at the arrival location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 連絡がつかない時の集合先も決めておくとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: It would also help to decide where to meet if you cannot contact each other.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 到着側の案内窓口にします。変更する時は、移る前にメッセージを送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡不能時の窓口集合と移動前連絡を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will use the information counter at the arrival location. If I change locations, I will send a message before moving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Agree to meet at the counter if contact fails and to send a message before moving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内票の時刻と降車地点をご確認ください。合流場所も、友人へまとめてお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the time and alighting point on the information sheet. Share the meeting place with your friend along with those details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。私の分と友人の分を一つの封筒へ入れました。別の世帯なので、分けて確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別世帯二人分の書類を分けたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I put my documents and my friend's in one envelope. We belong to separate households, so I would like to separate them for checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to separate two people's documents because they belong to different households. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 友人の分は、どこまで頼まれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: What exactly did your friend ask you to do with their documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持参だけ頼まれました。申請内容を変えたり、代わりに署名したりする依頼ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人からは持参のみで変更署名依頼なしと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: They only asked me to bring them. They did not ask me to change the application or sign on their behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend only asked you to deliver the documents, without changing or signing anything. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 代理持参の扱いも担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's also ask the staff in charge how delivery by a representative is handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。まず名前ごとに紙を分け、私の添付資料を友人の分へ入れないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 添付書類を名前ごとに分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. First I will separate the papers by name so that my supporting documents do not end up among my friend's.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate the supporting documents by name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の資料は特定できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you identify your own documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。私の名前のある二枚です。友人の説明で分からない所は、本人へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人書類を特定し不明友人内容は本人へ聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. They are these two sheets bearing my name. If there is anything I do not understand in my friend's explanation, I will contact them directly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Identify your own documents and say you will ask your friend about unclear points concerning theirs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分けてお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show them to us separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらが私の分です。友人の分が受け付けられなくても、私の分まで取り下げるとは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人の受付可否を別々に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: These are mine. Even if my friend's documents cannot be accepted, I do not intend to withdraw mine as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check whether each person's documents can be accepted separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二人の手続きを別に確認します。持参の範囲と本人確認を担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check the two procedures separately. Please tell the staff in charge the scope of your delivery role and about identity verification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 説明のことでご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any requests concerning the explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族にも内容を伝えたいです。携帯で録音してよいか、先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族への共有用録音の許可を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would also like to share the information with my family. I would like to ask beforehand whether I may record it on my phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask permission to record the explanation to share with your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 録音の扱いを担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the recording policy with the staff in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。ほかの患者さんの声も入るかもしれないので、勝手に録音は始めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 他患者の声に配慮し未録音と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. Other patients' voices might be captured too, so I will not start recording without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not recorded, out of consideration for other patients' voices. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 録音したいのは何の説明ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Which explanation would you like to record?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私の検査後の案内です。待合室の会話を集めたいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の検査後説明のみを指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The instructions after my examination. I am not trying to collect conversations in the waiting room.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify that you only want the explanation following your own examination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 録音できない場合は、メモや書面も相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: If recording is not possible, you can also ask about notes or written information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、できなければ要点を書いてもらう方法を希望します。家族へ伝える範囲も自分で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不可なら要点書面の代替を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then, if it is not possible, I would like the main points written down. I will also check for myself what information to share with my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request written main points as an alternative if recording is not allowed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 家族は受診に同席していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is your family attending the appointment with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は来ていません。私が理解できた内容を伝え、分からない所は推測して補いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不在家族へ理解済み範囲のみ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: They are not here today. I will tell them what I have understood and will not fill in unclear points by guessing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will share only what you understand with your absent family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ許可と書面の希望を伝えます。確認できるまで録音を始めずにお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will convey your request for permission and written information to the staff in charge. Please wait without recording until we have confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾得物の受取についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about collecting a found item?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。私の鞄が見つかったと連絡をもらいましたが、今日は仕事で受取へ来られません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 見つかった鞄を今日は受取不可と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I was told my bag has been found, but I am working today and cannot come to collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you cannot collect your found bag today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 代理の方に頼む予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you plan to ask someone to collect it for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人に頼めるか相談したいです。通知を渡すだけで受け取れるとは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人代理の条件確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to ask whether I can have my friend do it. I do not assume handing them the notice alone will let them collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to confirm the conditions for collection by your friend as a representative. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 代理受取の条件を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the conditions for collection by a representative with the staff in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。鞄の持ち主は私、来る人は友人と分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持主と引取者を分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I will make clear that I own the bag and my friend is the person coming to collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the owner from the person collecting the bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受取通知の番号はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have the collection notice number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらです。友人の名前と来られる時間も、条件が分かってから伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通知番号を提示し友人情報は条件後に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here it is. I will also give you my friend's name and the time they can come once I know the conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the notice number and say you will provide your friend's details after learning the conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な資料と準備を聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask what documents and preparations are needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。条件が合わなければ別の日に私が来ます。友人を先に向かわせません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不可なら本人別日受取で友人を先行させない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: All right. If the conditions cannot be met, I will come myself another day. I will not send my friend ahead first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will collect it yourself another day if necessary and will not send your friend ahead. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 番号と代理受取のご希望を担当へ伝えます。確認後に日時をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass the number and your request for collection by a representative to the staff in charge. Please discuss a date and time after confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 配送状況のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a delivery's status?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 配達済みと出ていますが、私は受け取っていません。家族が受けたかはまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 配達表示あり本人未受取家族未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It shows as delivered, but I have not received it. I have not yet asked whether someone in my family accepted it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that tracking shows delivery, you have not received it, and your family has not yet been asked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 追跡の番号をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please give me the tracking number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。今すぐ紛失と決めず、家族と置き場所も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号提示と即紛失断定を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. Instead of deciding immediately that it is lost, I would also like to check with my family and check where it may have been left.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the number and avoid immediately declaring the parcel lost. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 届いた時刻の表示はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Does it show a delivery time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日の午後です。家族はその時間に在宅だったので、先に連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 配達時刻と家族在宅を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: This afternoon. My family was home then, so I will contact them first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the delivery time and that your family was home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認が取れなければ担当へ相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you cannot confirm receipt, you can consult the staff in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。家族が受けていない場合は、その回答も含めて状況を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族回答後に追加相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. If my family did not accept it, I will include their answer when explaining the situation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will seek further help after receiving your family's answer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 宛先の住所も見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please double-check the delivery address too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。部屋番号まで合っているか確認し、未確認の事実を混ぜずに問い合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部屋番号と確認結果をそろえて問い合わせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: All right. I will check that it is correct down to the apartment number and make my inquiry without mixing in unconfirmed facts.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the apartment number and gather the confirmed results before inquiring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 番号と確認結果をお持ちください。配達表示と実際の受取状況を照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring the number and your findings. We will compare the delivered status with the actual receipt situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込先の登録でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to register a transfer recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今回の支払い先を保存したいですが、次も同じ口座を使ってよいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 振込先の次回利用可否と保存を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to save the recipient for this payment, but I do not know whether I can use the same account next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about saving the transfer recipient and whether the account can be reused next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 支払先の案内には何と書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: What do the recipient's instructions say?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今回の請求番号と口座があります。今後も同じ口座という説明は見つかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今回請求情報のみで継続指定なしと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: They list this invoice number and an account. I cannot find any explanation saying the same account will be used in future.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that only the current invoice information is provided, with no ongoing account designation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相手先の指定を確認してから登録してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please confirm the recipient's instructions before registering the account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では今日は保存を保留します。次の請求でも、金額と口座をその都度見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 保存を保留し都度口座額を見ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will hold off saving it today. For the next invoice too, I will check the amount and account each time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will postpone saving the account and check the account and amount each time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今回の振込自体は進めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you like to proceed with this transfer itself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今回の名義と番号は確認済みです。この一件だけを支払い、次回の指定は別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今回のみ確認済みで支払を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have checked the account holder's name and number for this payment. I will pay only this invoice and separately confirm the instructions for next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the details for this payment alone are verified and you would like to pay it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 登録せずに今回分を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check this payment without registering the account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。支払完了の控えには、今回の請求番号も残しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今回控えへ請求番号を残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will also keep this invoice number on the record of the completed payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will retain this invoice number on the payment record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今回の振込内容をご確認ください。継続利用する口座の登録は、相手の案内が分かってからご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the details of this transfer. Ask about registering an account for ongoing use once you know the recipient's instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: レシートについてご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ヨーグルトを三個買ったつもりですが、レシートは三個で、袋には二個しか見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: レシートの数と袋の中の数が違うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I thought I bought three yogurts, and the receipt says three, but I can only find two in the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the quantity on the receipt differs from the quantity in the bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋の中をこちらでも確認してよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: May we check inside your bag as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。別の袋はありません。買い物台にも戻ってみましたが、そこには残っていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別の袋と買い物台を確認したことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I have no other bag. I also went back to the packing counter, but nothing was left there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have checked for another bag and checked the packing counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 会計の時、三個をかごに入れていたか覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you remember having three in the basket at checkout?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 棚では三個取りました。ただ、レジで何個動かしたかは見ていなかったので、そこは言い切れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 棚で取った数と会計時に見ていない部分を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I took three from the shelf. But I was not watching how many were handled at the checkout, so I cannot say for certain about that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish how many you took from the shelf from what you did not observe at checkout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらで会計の記録と商品を確認します。今ある二個はどうなっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the checkout record and the goods. What condition are the two you have in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ開けていません。冷たい商品なので、確認の間は預かっていただけますか。返金と追加のどちらになるかは、確認してから相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未開封の商品を冷蔵して預かってほしいと頼み対応は確認後と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not opened them yet. Since they are chilled goods, could you hold them while you check? I would like to discuss whether to receive a refund or an additional item after the check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the unopened goods to be kept refrigerated and say you will discuss the resolution after checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 冷蔵してお預かりし、担当が記録を確認します。ご連絡できるようお名前を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will hold them in refrigeration while the staff member in charge checks the record. May I have your name so we can contact you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名前はこちらです。レシートの三個と袋の二個の違いを確認していただき、結果を聞いてから対応を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名前を伝え記録確認の結果を待って対応を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here is my name. Please check the difference between the three on the receipt and the two in the bag; I will decide what to do after hearing the findings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give your name and say you will wait for the record check before deciding on a resolution. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二個とレシートをお預かりします。確認の結果を担当からお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will hold the two items and your receipt. The staff member in charge will tell you the findings.
